description: Memory-efficient single-Spark Candidate for one-or-two-reference Qwen Image Edit 2511 jobs, using Comfy-Org's mixed-precision FP8 transformer, scaled-FP8 Qwen-VL encoder, and Qwen Image VAE. It preserves the 40-step quality schedule while reducing the declared admission envelope to 108.00 GB unified memory including reserve and 95.17 GB peak installation disk. Per-job knobs choose the seed and the step count; the output size follows the first reference image's aspect ratio.
title: Qwen Image Edit 2511 FP8mixed ComfyUI single Spark
